final: WITH race_avg AS (SELECT c.country AS country, ds.raceId AS raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS w FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country, ds.raceId), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(w) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS b FROM country_avg), kept AS (SELECT country, avg_wins FROM country_avg, bench WHERE avg_wins > b), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m FROM kept) SELECT k.country, k.avg_wins AS avg_wins, k.avg_wins - bench.b AS above_benchmark, k.avg_wins - m2.m AS above_second_mean FROM kept k, bench, m2 WHERE k.avg_wins > m2.m ORDER BY k.avg_wins DESC
